items.stem: What should a driver heed on mountain roads?

options.text: Speed controls and warnings about curves, grades and hazards
options.rationale: Option A is correct. In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings about curves, steep grades and other hazards.

options.text: Only the speed of the fastest vehicle
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings about curves, steep grades and other hazards.

options.text: Only the route number
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings about curves, steep grades and other hazards.

options.text: Only the distance to the destination
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings about curves, steep grades and other hazards.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct. In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings about curves, steep grades and other hazards.

options.text: Follow another vehicle closely to borrow its headlights

options.text: Only when absolutely necessary and the road ahead is clearly visible; never on the snow-spraying side

options.text: Whenever following distance becomes inconvenient
